clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, the Encrypted Memorandum guides new rogues to their trainer. Solm Hargrin disguises his invitation as official communication and calls scoundrels in exile to stand together.

In Anvilmar, rogues keep their presence quiet. Their trainer, Solm Hargrin, uses the Encrypted Memorandum to reach recruits without approaching them in plain view. Disguised as a directive from distant superiors, the coded parchment tells fledgling rogues where to find a mentor while avoiding the attention of local guards and suspicious townsfolk.
